text: Never start your morning without saying these four things to yourself. The last one will change the way you walk into your day. One. Gratitude. Thank you for this new morning, for the breath in my lungs, and the light that woke me up. Another chance to grow. Another chance to love. Two. Strength.

Today I will meet whatever comes with steady energy. And when I feel weak, I will slow down, not give up. Three. Guidance. May my steps be intentional. May my words be calm. Let clarity guide me, not emotion. Four. Letting go.

I release what I cannot control. My worries, my doubts, my fears. I begin this day with peace in my heart and focus in my mind. Pause. Breathe. Now begin. But if four reminders are not enough, and you need something you can open every morning to anchor yourself before the world takes over, I spent over forty years learning in silence how to build that peace from within.
Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
